claims: C1 if an instruction cannot be fulfilled, the assistant is obliged to be explicit about that
C2 after being explicit, the assistant is obliged to attempt to follow the remaining instructions
C3 if there is no way to proceed, the assistant is obliged to simply refuse to comply

concepts.name: instruction
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction given to the assistant in this conversation

concepts.name: cannot_be_fulfilled
concepts.gloss: I is an instruction the assistant cannot fulfill, either because it is beyond its capabilities or for another reason

concepts.name: remaining_instructions_after
concepts.gloss: R is the set of instructions that remain after instruction I is set aside as unfulfillable
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of 'the remaining instructions' after an unfulfillable one, so a relation naming them is needed

concepts.name: followable
concepts.gloss: R is a set of instructions the assistant is able to follow
concepts.inference: the obligation to 'attempt to follow' only makes sense for instructions within the assistant's capability

concepts.name: no_way_to_proceed
concepts.gloss: there is no way to proceed with instruction I, so refusal is the only option
concepts.inference: the clause's 'or simply refuse to comply if there is no way to proceed' requires a condition naming that situation

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: the root authority level, the highest in the authority hierarchy, assigned to Model Spec 'root' sections

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant is the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous in this document

asserts.read_back: when instruction % cannot be fulfilled, the assistant should be explicit about that and then attempt to follow the remaining instructions %
when instruction % cannot be fulfilled and there is no way to proceed, the assistant should simply refuse to comply

closure.reason: the clause obliges a particular response only when an instruction cannot be fulfilled; for all other instructions it says nothing, so silence permits any response
